libs.note: BH-6372.1. A perf/cost ticket's plan states a target metric and an outcome-replay acceptance test (prompts/plan-contract.md §16). pt_plan_rule puts the rule into the plan prompt, and bin/plan-gate.sh refuses a perf plan without them.

knobs.note: How many recent real inputs a perf/cost plan's outcome-replay acceptance test replays. Read by pt_replay_n through lib_env_apply perf-ticket, then env, then 50.
